verdict.rationale: Docusign's evidence covers e-signature workflows, CLM contract review AI, and an MCP connector that lets Claude query agreement status and trigger IAM workflow actions, but nothing describes an agent autonomously preparing an annual report or compliance filing end-to-end through the platform with minimal human input. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-driven filing/report generation, compliance-specific document preparation, or any case study of minimal-human-input annual report submission.
